messages:
Mina: Heads-up — PR #8365 is failing CI due to render-tests snapshot diffs. I pushed the snapshot-update branch this morning. Can someone take a quick look and approve the snapshot changes so I can merge? cc @Jorge @Sasha

Jorge: looking now, should be quick. are the diffs from the new prettierrc?

Sasha: quick skim — majority looks like spacing/indent changes, but one file (widget-renderer) actually changed HTML output. @Mina did you intend that behavioral change?

Mina: yep intended for widget-renderer, we updated how empty slots are rendered to avoid an extra wrapper. The rest is a prettier bump. I annotated the PR with which snapshots are intentional. I want to avoid triggering a full CI rerun until we have approvals to avoid wasting queue cycles.

CI Bot: build #8365.3 failed — 6 snapshot mismatches in render-tests. Failing files: packages/ui/__snapshots__/widget-renderer.snap (3 diffs), packages/ui/__snapshots__/toolbar.snap (3 diffs). Full logs: https://ci.internal/8365/logs

Taylor: I can approve the snapshot change if you want to land it as-is, but we should put a short follow-up to adjust the widget-renderer test to be more explicit about the new behavior. otherwise we risk a regression later.

Jorge: approve from me :white_check_mark: — changes look intentional and covered by the PR description.

Sasha: approve from me too. I left a tiny nit about a test name but not blocking. :thumbsup:

Mina: thanks! I'll merge after approvals then trigger a full rerun. Plan: merge snapshot-update -> run CI; if flake still shows up we'll pin the failing test and open a follow-up to unpin and add a stricter assertion.

Sasha: sounds good. also suggest adding a short note in the PR description about the prettier upgrade so future reviewers don't over-invest time in the whitespace diffs.

Mina: good call, added a note and the changelog entry.

CI Bot: merge blocked — requires 2 approvals.

Mina: merging now. Command I ran: ```bash
git checkout snapshot-update && gh pr merge 8365 --squash --body "merge snapshot update and prettier bump"
```

CI Bot: rerun queued by Mina (user mina). build #8366 started.

CI Bot: build #8366 passed — all checks green. :tada:

Taylor: awesome, nice and quick. thanks everyone for the speedy reviews.

Mina: thank you all — I'll follow up with the small test tweak PR in the afternoon.

Jorge: 👍

Sasha: ✅
